UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile information within the Polochka Exchange application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

username.description: A unique, user-chosen name for display purposes.

email.description: The user's email address, used for communication.

bio.description: An optional short description or biography provided by the user.

profilePictureUrl.description: An optional URL pointing to the user's profile picture.

locationName.description: A human-readable name for the user's primary location (e.g., city, neighborhood).

latitude.description: The geographic latitude of the user's primary location for proximity searches.

longitude.description: The geographic longitude of the user's primary location for proximity searches.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the user profile was updated.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Defines a classification for item listings, enabling organization and filtering.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

description.description: An optional detailed description of the category.

imageUrl.description: An optional URL to an image or icon representing the category.

ItemListing.title: ItemListing
ItemListing.description: Represents an item that a user has listed for exchange on the Polochka Exchange platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ItemListing entity.

title.description: The main title or name of the item being listed.

description.description: A detailed description of the item, including its features and any notable conditions.

ownerId.description: Reference to UserProfile, indicating the user who listed this item. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ItemListing)

categoryId.description: Reference to Category, classifying the item. (Relationship: Category 1:N ItemListing)

condition.description: The physical condition of the item (e.g., 'New', 'Used - Like New', 'Used - Good').

price.description: An optional suggested monetary value for the item, primarily for exchange context.

imageUrls.description: An array of URLs to images of the item, showcasing its appearance.

locationName.description: A human-readable name for the item's specific pickup or exchange location.

latitude.description: The geographic latitude of the item's location for proximity searches.

longitude.description: The geographic longitude of the item's location for proximity searches.

status.description: The current status of the item listing (e.g., 'available', 'pending exchange', 'exchanged', 'archived').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the item listing was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the item listing was updated.

Favorite.title: Favorite
Favorite.description: A record of an item that a user has 'liked' or favorited.

title.description: Denormalized item title for listing purposes.

imageUrl.description: Denormalized item image URL for listing purposes.
